name: agents-panel
description: A live Agents pane and a Checklist tab (the session's own task list, grouped, with Done / Now / You): a progress bar for the helpers, what the main loop is doing, every shell command of the session, and one card per helper agent or Codex run with its current action, recent actions, task, progress, tokens, approximate cost and time

showPane.title: Show the Agents and Checklist panes
showPane.description: The side pane with one card per helper agent, and the Checklist tab beside it. Off: neither opens by itself, /agents-panel says it is off, and nothing is tracked unless the bar above the prompt is on.

showBand.title: Show the progress bar above the prompt too
showBand.description: The helpers' progress bar (tasks done, percent and time left) is always at the top of the Agents pane. On: it is also drawn above the prompt while helpers run.
